brief.summary_1line: Kaikeyi reminds King Dasaratha of his earlier promise of two boons and prepares to claim them to advance her ambition for Bharata.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kaikeyi sits sternly on the floor of the chamber while King Dasaratha lifts her head into his arms, swearing by Rama to grant whatever she asks.
With a severe expression, Kaikeyi invokes the gods, sun, moon, and universe as witnesses while demanding the two promised boons from the king.
